C SIMPLE COLLECTION SIM / Choom Deck Lab

QUICK START · FOUR SIMPLE STEPS

Your cards. Your first deck.

Import a card list, find what you need, and put a crew together. Here are the basics.

First, open the app’s HTML file in Chrome or Edge.No installation or internet needed. This guide’s pictures are built in, too.
01 Add cards02 Build a deck03 Combine collections04 Save & share
01

Add your cards

  1. Click Import collection.
  2. Paste a list or upload a text file. Use one quantity and card name per line, such as 2 Bonnie and Clyde.
  3. Review the matches, then click Import.

For a quick adjustment, use a card’s Owned − / + buttons or type a quantity.

New to the app? Preview example opens a ready-made list you can try.

02

Find cards and build a deck

Search by name or use Owned, color, and card-type filters. Hover a card to see it larger; click it for full details.

Click + Deck to add a card. Choose 3 Legends, then build toward 40–50 other cards. The sidebar’s − / + controls change quantities, and deck checks point out issues.

Use + New for another deck. Saved decks lets you reopen or duplicate your builds.

03

Use a friend’s cards, too

  1. Click + New collection, give it a name, and import that person’s list.
  2. Check both collections under Deck sources. Available quantities are now combined.
  3. Open Sources & copies to filter the finished deck by owner. Use Assign to choose exact copies, or download that person’s pull list.

Which collection am I editing? Owned controls change only the collection selected in EDIT COLLECTION.

04

Save, back up, and share

Changes save automatically in your browser. Keep the app in the same location and use Backup regularly.

Keep everything

Backup downloads all collections and saved decks. Restore loads that backup on another browser or computer.

Share just one deck

Use Export in the deck panel to copy or download its list. Your friend can use Import to load it.

Sending the app’s HTML alone does not send your saved collections or decks. Include a deck export or backup if you want to share those.

On a phone, use Filters and View deck to open those panels.

Pictures show sample collections and a deck in progress.
